main_text.l: 28.Art.24. Non fuisse latriam, sed reverentiam debi-tam animæ Samuelis.] quid latriam?an ergo vel ἀξιώσεως[?] bona fide vnquam poterit exhiberi dæmo-ni?negat natura, negat Christus Matth. 4. Omnino aut ciuilem ei, aut religiosum honore habuit Saul: non autem ciuilem, nam consulebat pro Deo: religiosum igitur. At non latria, fuit, inquies. Primum distinctionem illam latriæ negamus, & suo loco refellemus in sequente controuersia. Deinde esto, sane, valeat quantum valere potest:at religiosum cig[?] magis Samuel suscepisset, quâ aut Angelus in Apocalypsi, aut Petrus & Paulus in Actis Apostolorū*
29. Art. 26. tam non respondendo quando interrogabatur, quàm respondendo quando non interrogabatur:] prius Scriptura affirmat bis expressis verbis: posterius ne innuit quidem. hoc itaque negamus.
30. Ibid. potuisset Saul declinare bellum, & pœnam sibi à Deo paratam:] negatur consequens: nam Deus Sauli fuisset responsurus pro sapientia, iustitia, & veritate sua: vana igitur argumentatio.
31. Art. 27. Purgatorium, infernum, ac limbos Patrū & puerorum, loca subterranea esse.] Hanc conclusionem inde à nota quarta in superioribus refel-limus.
I. Art. I. Quantum ad primum, difficultas est satis magna,] imò nulla plane acquiescentibus in simpli-citate Scripturæ sacræ. Nam distinctio quidem illa quatuor locorum nihil cum ea commune habet.
2.Ib. Cui revelationi multas alias conformes adducit

page.notes: The Greek word after "vel" is only partly legible; ἀξιώσεως is a guess and is marked [?]. "cig" after "religiosum" is unclear and is marked [?]. The mark "*" after "Apostolorū" is a printed reference mark, copied as it stands. The last line is cut off by the foot of the page, and the paragraph may continue on the next page. Printed "Pvrg." and "Pvrgatorium" have been normalised to u/v per the rules. Long s is written as plain s throughout. The "?" in "ni?negat" is printed punctuation and is copied as printed.
